brief: A carved oak side chair: a seat 46 cm wide and 42 cm deep, 45 cm up, its edge moulded; turned front legs; square back posts rising to 95 cm; a carved top rail with a running scroll, a splat carved with a rosette, a rail round under the seat, and low stretchers between the legs. Waxed oak, darkened, worn where hands lift it.
